label: miso 45 cc capacity
definition: miso-45 (G-23 root-cause fix): miso-44 recipe + cc_capacity_reconcile with the MISO demonstrated-capacity cap table (derive_cc_capacity_reconcile.py --iso MISO --mode cap). Root cause of the CC_REGULAR +20 TWh overrun: EIA-860 reports 7 MISO CC plants' steam (CA) rows with BLOCK-level Summer Capacity while nameplate stays component-level; the loader's summer-preferred pmax double-counts the CTs (-2,714 MW phantom, 6 of 7 plants MISO-South, e.g. Union Power 3,457 MW modeled vs 2,428 nameplate / 2,318 CAMPD p99.9 / 2,354 EIA-860 winter). Cap = plant's own measured CAMPD p99.9 sustained peak - zero new DOF. RESULT vs miso-44: CC_REGULAR +20.0/+19.1/+3.1 -> +6.7/+7.2/-7.3 TWh; ST_GAS -8.5/-11.0/-10.5 -> -2.0/-4.6/-6.1; C1 12/16 -> 15/16 (free 8/12 -> 11/12); C3b PASS. 2025 residual moves onto the open import-starvation + coal-sigmoid rows (audit boxes 3-4). Full audit: docs/multi-iso/miso-cc-overrun-rootcause-2026-07.md.
